title: HIS OWN MAP MARKER STAYS ON TOP
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-08, in the v19.02 map label placer: the labels were drawn after the whole map, so a landmark name or a CACHE tag printed over his own gold marker and over the party dots, gold letters on the gold dot, the two things his Q23 says are never lost. The marker and the party dots are drawn after the labels again.
now: On the sector map your own marker and your teammate are always on top of the writing.
